settings.title: Questions?
settings.lede: Quick answers about the soda, the cans, and getting them to your door.

settings.question: What's actually in Blackpeak?
settings.answer: Carbonated water, real fruit juice and flavor, a touch of cane sugar (just 9g), and a little citric acid for snap. No artificial colors, no artificial sweeteners, nothing you can't pronounce. The full ingredient list is on each can.

settings.question: Is this a healthy soda?
settings.answer: Better-for-you, not a wellness gimmick. Each 330ml can is about 45–50 calories with 8–10g of sugar — a fraction of a regular soda's ~140 calories and 39g. It's sweetened with real fruit and a touch of cane sugar, with nothing artificial. We won't call it a health drink, but it's an easy upgrade from cola.

settings.question: How much caffeine does it have?
settings.answer: Zero. All three flavors are caffeine-free, so you can crack one open at any time of day without thinking twice.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We ship across the continental US. Free shipping on orders over $35. International is coming — get on the fizz list and we'll let you know when your country goes live.

settings.question: How fast will my order get to me?
settings.answer: Most orders ship within 1 business day and arrive in 3–5 business days. You'll get a tracking link the moment your case leaves our warehouse.

settings.question: Can I return it if I don't love it?
settings.answer: Yes. If a flavor isn't your thing, email us within 30 days and we'll refund the case — no need to ship it back.

settings.question: How does the subscription work?
settings.answer: The Monthly Drop sends a variety case every month at a lower price than one-off. Pause, swap flavors, or cancel anytime from your account.

settings.question: Are the cans recyclable?
settings.answer: Yes. Aluminum is one of the most recyclable materials on earth and can be back on a shelf within 60 days. Rinse, recycle, repeat.
